name: bar_chart
description: A simple bar chart comparing 2-8 values.

unit.description: Unit shown after each value, e.g. 'rpm'

name: block_flow
description: A left-to-right chain of labelled blocks joined by arrows, with a bright pulse travelling through it to show how a signal, request or piece of data moves from the first block to the last.

blocks.description: the stages in order (2 to 6 short labels (a few words each))

name: bullet_points
description: A heading with up to 6 key points revealed one by one. Good for lists of facts or steps.

name: callout
description: A highlighted box for one key takeaway, definition, or warning. Good as the final scene.

text.description: The message, one or two sentences

example.text: A synchronous motor runs at exactly the speed of the rotating field.

name: compare_two
description: Two columns comparing two things side by side, each with a title and 2-5 points.

name: concept_map
description: Concept map: a central idea with branches and sub-ideas spreading both ways.

branches.description: 2-6 items written 'Branch: sub, sub' (up to 4 subs each)

name: equation
description: Shows one formula (LaTeX) with an optional title and a legend explaining each symbol.

latex.description: LaTeX without $ delimiters, e.g. N_s = \frac{120 f}{P}

title.description: What the formula gives, e.g. 'Synchronous speed'

name: flowchart
description: A chain of 2-8 labelled boxes connected by arrows (process, signal path, cause and effect).

steps.description: Box labels in order, under 30 characters each

name: focus_ring
description: A pulsing ring drawn round one idea in a row to say 'look here', optionally moving on to a second one.

items.description: the ideas shown side by side (2 to 6 short labels (a few words each))

focus.description: which item to ring first, counting from 0

then.description: optional second item to move the ring to, counting from 0; -1 for none

name: function_plot
description: Plots y = f(x) on labelled axes. Expression may use x, pi, e; sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan; sinh, cosh, tanh; exp, log, ln, log10, log2, sqrt, abs, floor, ceil; and + - * / % ^ (or **).

name: hierarchy_tree
description: Hierarchy tree (org chart or taxonomy): a root with parents and children below it.

branches.description: 2-6 items written 'Branch: sub, sub' (up to 4 subs each)

name: spotlight
description: Stage-light focus: a row of ideas appears, then everything dims except the one the narration is about, then the lights come back up. Good for 'of all these, this is the one that matters'.

items.description: the ideas shown side by side (2 to 6 short labels (a few words each))

focus.description: which item to light up, counting from 0

name: timeline
description: Timeline: events in order, each a year and a short description, highlighted one by one.

title.description: title in the middle of the line

name: title_card
description: Opening or section title with an optional subtitle. Use as the first scene.

name: bohr_atom
description: Bohr model of an atom (H to Ar): nucleus and orbiting electron shells, counts labelled.

name: chemical_equation
description: A chemical equation with atom counts per element, showing whether it is balanced.

name: molecule_structure
description: Skeletal structure of a small organic molecule.

name: array_sort
description: Bubble, selection or insertion sort of a short array, step by step.

name: big_o_growth
description: Plots how the work grows with input size n for several Big-O classes (O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(n^2), O(2^n)), so the gap between them is obvious.

name: binary_representation
description: Shows how a number from 0 to 255 is written in binary: eight bits with place values 128 to 1, deciding each bit by subtraction, then adding the lit places back up.

name: binary_search
description: Binary search in a sorted array: look at the middle, discard the half that cannot hold the target, repeat. Shows why it takes about log2(n) steps.

name: binary_search_tree
description: Binary search tree from inserted values, optionally traversed.

name: dp_table
description: Dynamic programming on the longest common subsequence of two short words: the table is filled cell by cell from smaller sub-problems, then traced back to read the answer.

name: file_tree
description: Folder and file tree of a project, with chosen files highlighted in turn.

highlight.description: up to 4 of those paths (folders or files) to point out

name: graph_traversal
description: BFS or DFS on a small undirected graph, showing the visit order.

name: hash_table
description: Hash table with chaining: each key is hashed to a bucket (sum of character codes mod table size) and collisions form a chain. Shows O(1) lookup and what a collision is.

name: linked_list_reverse
description: Reverses a singly linked list in place with the prev / curr / next pointers, flipping one arrow per step.

name: queue_operations
description: A queue of capacity 5 starting with 1, 2, 3: enqueue at the back, dequeue from the front (first in, first out).

operations.description: up to 8 steps: 'enqueue 4' or 'dequeue' (never more than 5 items, never empty)

name: recursion_tree
description: Call tree of the naive recursive Fibonacci fib(n): the tree is built level by level, then the repeated sub-calls are highlighted to show why plain recursion is wasteful (and why memoization helps).

name: sequence_diagram
description: Sequence diagram: 2-5 participants with lifelines and up to 8 messages in order (requests solid, replies dashed). For TCP handshakes, HTTP requests, login flows, API calls.

actors.description: 2-5 participant names, left to right, e.g. ['Client', 'Server']

messages.description: up to 8 messages: 'Client->Server: SYN' for a request, 'Server-->Client: SYN-ACK' (two dashes) for a reply

name: stack_operations
description: A stack (LIFO) as values are pushed on and popped off.

name: block_diagram
description: Control block diagrams: a feedback loop with signal pulses, a PID controller's three parallel paths, a state-space diagram, or a cascade with a summing junction and live scopes.

show_scopes.description: animate signals through the cascade diagram

name: bode_plot
description: Bode plot (magnitude and phase against frequency) with straight-line asymptotes, a frequency sweep, and the gain and phase margins.

poles.description: poles as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

zeros.description: zeros as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

name: nyquist_plot
description: Nyquist plot of a loop transfer function traced around the critical point minus one, with its mirror image and the encirclement count that decides stability.

poles.description: poles as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

zeros.description: zeros as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

name: pid_response
description: PID tuning on a plant's step response: proportional gain alone leaves an offset and ringing, integral action closes the gap, derivative action damps the overshoot.

name: pole_zero_map
description: Pole-zero map in the s-plane (stable on the left) or the z-plane (stable inside the unit circle), with a pole sliding to show how stability changes.

poles.description: poles as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

zeros.description: zeros as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

domain.description: s for continuous time, z for discrete time

name: root_locus
description: Root locus: the closed-loop poles walking across the s-plane as the gain increases from zero, with the critical gain where they cross into instability.

poles.description: open-loop poles as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

zeros.description: open-loop zeros as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

name: time_response
description: Step or impulse response of a system from its poles and zeros, with rise time, overshoot and settling time marked and the pole-zero map beside it.

poles.description: poles as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

zeros.description: zeros as pairs real, imaginary, real, imaginary (up to 4 values); [-1, 0] is the single pole at -1

name: btree_index
description: B-tree index built from keys, then one key inserted or searched.

name: database_table
description: A table as rows are inserted, updated, deleted or selected, with the SQL shown.

columns.description: 2-5 column names; the first is the key

operations.description: 'insert a, b' | 'update row 2 col value' | 'delete row 1' | 'select row 2'

name: ac_waveform
description: Animated sine wave(s) with a moving marker. Use 3 phases to show a balanced three-phase supply.

frequency_hz.description: Supply frequency, used for the period note

name: circuit
description: A closed loop circuit with 1-6 elements and animated current flow. Element format 'type:label'; types: battery, ac_source, resistor, capacitor, inductor, lamp, switch.

name: circuit_diagram
description: Circuit schematic of 1-6 standard symbols. Types: cell, resistor, variable_resistor, capacitor, inductor, switch, closed_switch, diode, zener, thermistor.

name: phasor_diagram
description: Rotating phasor arrows on a circle. Shows magnitude and phase angle of voltages or currents (empty list = balanced three-phase set).

name: power_triangle
description: Right triangle of real power P, reactive power Q and apparent power S with the power-factor angle. Use for power factor and reactive power.

real_power_kw.description: Real power P in kW, above 0

lagging.description: True for an inductive (lagging) load, false for a capacitive (leading) load

name: rotating_field
description: Stator cross-section showing how three-phase currents create a rotating magnetic field, with the synchronous speed formula Ns = 120 f / P.

name: synchronous_motor
description: Cross-section of a synchronous motor: the rotor locks onto the rotating stator field and turns at exactly synchronous speed; a dial and torque meter show the load angle growing as load increases.

name: torque_speed_curve
description: Torque versus speed characteristic of a motor with a marker sliding along it. Use for comparing how motors behave under load.

name: transformer
description: Two windings on an iron core: flux links them and the voltage scales by the turns ratio Vs/Vp = Ns/Np. Shows step-up or step-down.

turns_ratio.description: Ns/Np, between 0.1 and 10 (above 1 steps up, below 1 steps down)

name: ad_as_model
description: Aggregate demand and supply: a demand or supply shock, then the long-run return to potential output.

name: binomial_tree
description: Recombining price tree and a European call valued by working backward from the last step with risk-neutral probability.

name: bond_price_yield
description: Bond price against yield (inverse, convex); or duration tangent vs convexity parabola vs the real curve.

view.description: price curve, or duration and convexity

name: brownian_motion
description: Random walk, Brownian motion or geometric Brownian motion (prices): many paths, and the histogram of where they end.

name: garch_volatility
description: Volatility clustering: returns over a band that widens after big moves (GARCH), or how volatility fades after one shock.

view.description: bands over returns, or decay after one shock

alpha.description: reaction to the last move, 0.01 to 0.3

shock_at.description: day of the big move (bands view), 5 to 80

name: is_lm_ad_as
description: IS-LM and AD-AS side by side, linked: one policy or supply shock moves both diagrams.

name: is_lm_model
description: IS-LM diagram: a monetary or fiscal policy change shifts one curve and moves interest rate and output.

name: option_greeks
description: Option value curve sharpening toward its payoff as time runs out, with delta tangent and a Greek (delta, gamma, theta, vega) beside it.

name: option_payoff
description: Option profit or loss at expiry as a hockey stick with break-even and max gain/loss; also straddle, bull spread, collar.

name: order_book_matching
description: Limit order book with bids, asks and spread: a buy order sweeps price levels, partly fills, or joins the queue (price-time priority).

name: solow_growth
description: Solow growth model: change savings, population growth or depreciation and watch the steady state move.

name: supply_demand
description: Supply and demand curves; one curve shifts and the equilibrium price and quantity move.

size.description: how far the curve shifts, 1 to 3

name: yield_curve_shift
description: Yield curve (3M to 30Y) morphing under a parallel shift, steepening, flattening or inversion, with what it means.

name: code_walkthrough
description: Shows up to 8 lines of code and highlights them one at a time with a short note per line. Use to explain code or an algorithm line by line. For longer code use several scenes with first_line set so numbering continues; narration should mention the lines in order.

lines.description: 1-8 lines of code, indentation with spaces, each under 60 characters

notes.description: One short plain-words note per line, same order and same count as lines (under 70 chars each)

language.description: Language name shown as a label

first_line.description: Number of the first line shown, so long code can be split across scenes

notes: Define a function taking a list
Start the running sum at zero
Add the item to the sum
example.title: Summing a list

name: problem_statement
description: A numerical problem laid out as what is Given and what to Find. Use right after the title in a worked-problem video.

given.description: 2-6 given values, short, e.g. 'Supply frequency f = 50 Hz'

find.description: What must be found, e.g. 'Synchronous speed N_s'

name: solution_steps
description: A worked solution: 2-5 steps (6 at most), each with a name, one formula line and a short note, then a boxed final answer. Use after problem_statement. Put one calculation per step (formula, substitution, result).

steps.items: {label: step name under 25 chars, math: ONE LaTeX line without $, note: under 60 chars of plain words}

answer.description: Final answer with its unit, e.g. 'N_s = 1500 rpm'. Leave empty to skip the answer box.

steps.label: Write the formula
steps.note: Speed set by frequency and poles

name: trace_table
description: A dry-run table that fills in one row per step, to follow how variables change while an algorithm or process runs.

rows.description: Up to 8 rows, cells separated by '|', e.g. 'lo=0 | hi=6 | mid=3'. Same cell count as columns.

name: attention_head
description: One self-attention head: project each word into a query, key and value, score every pair, then mix the values by the scores. With several heads it shows the split into parallel heads and the concatenation back.

tokens.description: the sentence as tokens (words or sub-words, 2 to 8, each a short string)

causal.description: hide future words, as a language model does while generating

heads.description: 1 shows a single head in three stages; 2 to 4 shows several heads side by side

name: attention_heatmap
description: Attention as a grid of who looks at whom: raw scores, scaling, the causal mask, then softmax turning each row into shares that add to one. Optionally with arcs from one word to the words it attends to.

tokens.description: the sentence as tokens (words or sub-words, 2 to 8, each a short string)

query_index.description: which word the arcs start from, counting from 0; -1 means the last word

name: kv_cache
description: The KV cache in LLM decoding: each new token writes its key and value into a slot (a sliding window overwrites the oldest), or a timeline comparing the work with and without the cache.

view.description: slots filling up, or the work saved

name: neural_network
description: Feed-forward neural network, layer by layer, with an optional forward pass.

layers.description: neurons per layer, 2-6 layers of 1-8, e.g. [3, 5, 4, 2]

name: positional_encoding
description: Positional encoding in a transformer: sine and cosine waves of different speeds giving every position a unique pattern, how that pattern is added to a word's embedding, or the whole table seen from above as a heatmap.

tokens.description: the words for the sum view (words or sub-words, 2 to 8, each a short string)

d_model.description: embedding size, an even number from 4 to 16

n_positions.description: how many positions to draw, 4 to 24

name: qkv_projection
description: Query, key and value: the same word embedding multiplied by three weight matrices, lighting up each word's row in Q, K and V.

tokens.description: the sentence as tokens (words or sub-words, 2 to 8, each a short string)

d_head.description: size of each query, key and value vector, 2 to 4

name: branch_prediction
description: Branch prediction: the predicted path versus the real one, the flush penalty on a miss, and the saturating-counter state machine.

outcomes.description: branch outcomes in order, 1 = taken, 0 = not taken (up to 8)

name: cache_access
description: Set-associative cache: each address is split into tag, index and offset, the set is searched, and the access hits or replaces a line (LRU or FIFO).

addresses.description: byte addresses 0-255 to look up in order (up to 8)

name: cpu_pipeline
description: 5-stage CPU pipeline (IF ID EX MEM WB) as a cycle-by-cycle grid: stall bubbles labelled with their cause, forwarding arrows, and branch flushes.

forwarding.description: forward results between stages instead of stalling

name: memory_system
description: Memory system: the cache hierarchy with latencies and average access time, the address and data buses with RAM row/column selection, or DMA moving a block while the CPU stays free.

levels.description: cache levels in the hierarchy view, 1 to 3

words.description: words moved in the dma view, 1 to 8

name: mosfet_channel
description: MOSFET cross-section: the inversion channel forms as VGS passes the threshold and pinches off as VDS rises, with the drain current. Views: cross-section, or the I_D-V_DS characteristics.

kind.description: transistor type (voltages are magnitudes for pmos)

name: pn_junction
description: PN junction: electrons and holes diffusing across the junction, a depletion region that widens in reverse bias and narrows in forward bias. Views: carriers, band diagram, I-V curve.

name: serial_bus
description: Serial bus waveforms with the sampling instants and frame fields: SPI (all four modes), I2C, UART, USB (NRZI and bit stuffing), CAN (with arbitration), and a differential pair that cancels noise.

mode.description: SPI mode 0-3 (CPOL, CPHA); for UART 0 = no parity, 1 = even, 2 = odd

name: electric_field
description: Field arrows around 1-4 point charges.

name: falling_objects
description: Shapes dropped under gravity, bouncing off floor and walls.

name: gear_train
description: Two meshing gears; the tooth counts set the speed and torque ratio.

driver_teeth.description: teeth on the driving gear, 8 to 40

driven_teeth.description: teeth on the driven gear, 8 to 60

name: lens_rays
description: Parallel rays through a convex or concave lens.

name: pendulum
description: Simulated pendulum; 2-3 bobs are chaotic with a traced path.

name: standing_wave
description: Animated standing waves for chosen harmonics.

name: damper_windings
description: Damper (amortisseur) windings in a synchronous machine's rotor: how slip makes bars cut flux and the induced current pulls the rotor back in step.

poles.description: number of poles, an even number from 2 to 8

name: dc_dc_converter
description: DC-DC converter (buck, boost, buck-boost): the switching schematic, the inductor current ramping up and down, and the output-to-input ratio curve as the duty cycle changes.

duty.description: fraction of each period the switch is on, 0.1 to 0.9

name: foc_transform
description: Field-oriented (vector) motor control: Clarke and Park transforms turning three sine currents into flat d and q values, the rotating d-q frame, torque from the q-axis current, or the full control block diagram.

name: power_grid
description: An electrical grid: generator, buses, lines and loads with power-flow arrows and a fault that breakers isolate, or substation bus layouts (single bus, double bus, breaker ring) with the route the current takes.

show_fault.description: show a fault and the breakers clearing it

name: power_stability
description: Power-system stability: the rotor angle swinging after a disturbance, the equal-area criterion for a fault cleared at a chosen angle, or a generator's short-circuit current decaying from subtransient to steady state.

inertia_h.description: inertia constant H in seconds, 1 to 12 (swing view)

mechanical_power.description: mechanical power in per unit, 0.1 to 1.2

clearing_angle_deg.description: angle at which the fault is cleared, 20 to 80 degrees (equal_area view)

dc_offset.description: include the decaying DC offset (fault_current view)

name: pwm_inverter
description: Pulse-width modulation: a triangle carrier racing a sine reference to make switching pulses, driving a single-phase H-bridge (bipolar or unipolar) or a three-phase inverter.

modulation_index.description: reference amplitude over carrier amplitude, 0.1 to 1

carrier_ratio.description: carrier frequency over reference frequency, 9 to 31
